## Summary of Findings

The project is the Spring PetClinic REST sample. All owner-creation business rules live in **one controller class**, not the service layer. Owner counting is done in-memory via `findAllOwners().stream()` — there is **no dedicated repository count-by-city method**. Critically, **`capacityWarning` does not yet exist** in the model, OpenAPI spec, or DTO — only the hard rejection at 50 and a test that expects the field are present.

### 1. The hard rejection at 50 (already implemented)

**File:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`

The gate is invoked in `createNewOwner` (returns `409 Conflict`):
```java

```

The check itself (lines 677-683) — case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed city match, counting all owners in-memory:
```java
677:    private boolean cityIsAtCapacity(String city) {
678:        String normalizedCity = normalizeName(city);
679:        long count = this.clinicService.findAllOwners().stream()
680:            .filter(existing -> normalizeName(existing.getCity()).equals(normalizedCity))
681:            .count();
682:        return count >= 50;
683:    }
```
Note the sibling `dailyLimitReached` (lines 693-698, `>= 100`) follows the identical in-memory counting pattern. `normalizeName` is at lines 664-666.

### 2. Controller — owner creation endpoint

**File:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`
- `addOwner(...)` — public entry point (thin; handles idempotency), lines 119-138. Endpoint is `POST /api/owners`.
- `createNewOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` — the create pipeline, lines 258-285. Order of gates: normalize (400) → daily limit (429) → **city capacity (409)** → duplicate identity (409) → `assignDerivedAttributes` → `saveOwner` → audit → map to `OwnerDto` → 201.
- `assignDerivedAttributes(...)` — lines 508-517. **This is where a `capacityWarning` would be computed/set**, alongside `setBulkSignupWarning`, `setNamesakeCount`, etc. It currently sets: customerCode, namesakeCount, membershipNumber, bulkSignupWarning, householdSize, membershipLevelCap, possibleDuplicate.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or
            'DR'). When supplied it is used to compose the read-only
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility as a flat single-line address. When the structured
            'addressLine1' (with optional 'addressLine2') is supplied it is
            preferred, and this field is returned as the composed value: the
            normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same
            way (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, upper-cased, common
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: 'Apt 2'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. Stored and returned in E.164 form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed city-to-region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is
            rejected with 400. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it is used to
            derive the read-only 'ageBand', the owner's age band computed
            against the registrationDate. Stored and returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. Owners with the same lastName and postcode belong to
            the same household (they share a deterministic householdId). Setting this
            flag true admits the owner as a declared household member, which is not
            flagged as a possible duplicate even when it soft-matches an existing
            household member. Duplicate detection is keyed on the identity key, so a
            second household member with a different telephone is admitted as a soft
            match rather than rejected.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title followed by a
                single space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR who') when a title is
                present, or just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone number formatted for humans: a
                leading '+' and country code, a space, then the national digits
                grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone'
                stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the canonical region derived from the owner's postcode
                (falling back to its city, otherwise 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the
                first eight upper-case hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256
                digest of the owner's normalised telephone concatenated with its
                lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-9F86D081'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal
                digits contained in the owner's customerCode, processed
                right-to-left with every second digit doubled.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household,
                derived deterministically as the first 12 lower-case hexadecimal
                characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's normalised
                lastName, a '|' separator and its postcode. Owners with the same
                lastName and postcode therefore resolve to the same householdId.
              type: string
              example: '9e107d9d372b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Counts only owners created before this one.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year that contains its
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on
                1 July and is labelled by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registrationDate from July to December falls in the next calendar
                year's fiscal year. Absent when no registrationDate is present.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where <customerCode> is the owner's customer code and YY is the
                last two digits of the fiscal year that contains the
                registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-9F86D081-M27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, a non-negative score derived from
                its factors: starting at 0, add 2 when an email is present, add 1
                when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3 or more
                (householdSize) and add 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds a year
